name: Iron Burrow
shortDescription: Blast through brick mazes in a drill-tank and guard the Core from Rustbugs.
fullDescription:
Iron Burrow is a top-down arcade tank shooter set deep underground. You drive the Burrower, a stubby iron drill-tank, through mazes of clay brick and steel plate. At the bottom of every map sits the glowing Burrow Core. Your job is easy to explain and hard to pull off: destroy 20 Rustbugs, the beetle-shaped scrap tanks that roll in from above, and keep the Core in one piece. One hit on the Core and the stage is lost.

The maze is part of the fight. Every shot chews through brick a quarter of a block at a time, so the layout changes while you play. Cut a shortcut to reach a Rustbug faster, open a firing lane, or think twice before you blast a hole that leaves the Core exposed. Steel shrugs off a basic gun, so it shapes the routes you and the Rustbugs can take until your gun is strong enough to break it.

Some Rustbugs flash. Hit one and it drops a pickup on the field. A star upgrades your gun, a bubble makes you briefly invulnerable, rebar turns the wall around the Core into steel for a while, a quake wipes out every Rustbug on the field, freeze stops them in their tracks, and hull gives you an extra life. Grab pickups quickly, because they do not stay for long.

When things go wrong, boosters are your emergency kit. Bubble Shield protects your tank, Shockwave clears the field, Steel Fortress hardens the Core wall, and Spare Hull adds a life before a stage or lets you continue after a defeat. New players start with 2 of each, and clearing stages earns more.

The campaign has 30 stages across three chapters: Clay Tunnels, The Iron Works and Magma Depths, with up to 3 stars per stage. Clear stage 5 to unlock Siege, an endless mode with a leaderboard. Daily rewards follow a 7-day cycle.

Play in your browser on desktop with the keyboard, or on your phone with a floating stick and a FIRE button, in portrait or landscape. The interface is available in English, German, Spanish, French and Russian. There are no ads at all.

portal.body:
Iron Burrow is a top-down arcade tank shooter set deep underground. You drive the Burrower, a stubby iron drill-tank, through mazes of brick and steel. At the bottom of every map sits the glowing Burrow Core. Destroy 20 Rustbugs, the beetle-shaped scrap tanks that roll in from above, and keep the Core in one piece. One hit on the Core and the stage is lost.

Every shot chews through brick a quarter of a block at a time, so the maze changes as you play. Cut a shortcut, but think twice before leaving the Core exposed. Steel shrugs off a basic gun.

Some Rustbugs flash. Hit one and it drops a pickup. A star upgrades your gun, a bubble makes you briefly invulnerable, rebar turns the wall around the Core into steel for a while, a quake wipes out every Rustbug, freeze stops them, and hull gives you an extra life. Grab pickups quickly, as they do not stay long.

Boosters are your emergency kit: Bubble Shield, Shockwave, Steel Fortress and Spare Hull. New players start with 2 of each, and clearing stages earns more.

The campaign has 30 stages across three chapters: Clay Tunnels, The Iron Works and Magma Depths. Each stage awards up to 3 stars, 90 in total. Clear stage 5 to unlock Siege, an endless mode for chasing a high score. Leaderboards track your best Siege run and campaign score, and a 7-day daily reward cycle rewards each visit.

Controls. It plays in your browser on desktop and phones. On a keyboard, move with the arrow keys or WASD, hold Space or J to fire, press 1, 2 or 3 to use boosters, and press Esc or P to pause. On touch, a floating stick drives the tank in four directions and a FIRE button shoots, plus booster and pause buttons. Portrait and landscape both work.

The interface is available in English, German, Spanish, French and Russian. Settings cover Music, Sound, Reduce Motion and Vibration on touch devices. There are no ads at all. An optional shop offers booster packs, but the whole campaign is playable without it. An internet connection is required.

faq.question: How do I control the tank?
faq.answer: On a keyboard, move with the arrow keys or WASD, hold Space or J to fire, press 1, 2 or 3 to use boosters, and press Esc or P to pause. On a touch screen, drag the floating stick to drive in four directions, hold the FIRE button to shoot and tap the booster buttons on the HUD.

faq.question: Which languages does Iron Burrow support?
faq.answer: The game interface is available in English, German, Spanish, French and Russian.

faq.question: How do I unlock Siege?
faq.answer: Clear stage 5 of the campaign. Siege is an endless mode with a leaderboard for your best score.

controls.input: Arrow keys or WASD. On touch screens, drag the floating stick (4 directions).
Hold Space or J. On touch screens, hold the FIRE button.
Press 1, 2 or 3 (Numpad 1 to 3 also works). On touch screens, tap the booster buttons on the HUD.
Esc or P. On touch screens, tap the pause button on the HUD.
Drag the floating stick to drive, hold FIRE to shoot. Portrait and landscape both work.
